checks.criterion: Autenticação demo com perfis administrador e operador
checks.name: demo-auth-profiles
checks.evidence: Public preview login accepted admin and operator credentials; role badges showed Administrador and Operador.

checks.criterion: Autenticação demo com perfis administrador e operador
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: POST /api/auth/login returned 200 for both demo roles; invalid password returned 401; /api/auth/me returned 200.

checks.name: admin-login-dashboard
checks.evidence: Public preview rendered KPI cards, demand chart, replenishment alerts, stock health, and recent movements after admin login.

checks.name: test_tscheck_dashboard
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: GET /api/dashboard returned 200 with KPI fields, stock distribution, demand points, critical products, and recent movements.

checks.name: admin-creates-product
checks.evidence: Admin created a unique tscheck fixture SKU and its product table row displayed with Saudável status; rerun-safe fixture produced no console error.

checks.name: test_tscheck_products
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: POST /api/products returned 200 for unique fixture, GET /api/products contained its returned id, and duplicate SKU returned 409.

checks.name: movement-updates-history
checks.evidence: UI registered a tscheck entrada movement and displayed its reason in movement history.

checks.name: test_tscheck_movements
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: POST /api/movements returned 200, GET /api/products reflected increased stock, and negative stock returned 422.

checks.name: forecast-recommendations
checks.evidence: Forecast page showed model explanation and recommendations table; period selector changed unambiguously to 30 dias.

checks.name: test_tscheck_forecast
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: GET /api/forecast?days=7,15,30,60 returned 200 with model data; invalid 8-day horizon returned 422.

checks.name: operator-role-permissions
checks.evidence: Operator UI showed products while Novo produto was absent and import dropzone was disabled with admin-only messaging.

checks.name: test_tscheck_permissions
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: operator GET /api/products and /api/dashboard returned 200; product creation and import returned 403.

checks.name: csv-import-export
checks.evidence: Admin downloaded the CSV template, selected CSV, saw preview, received POST /api/import/products status 200, and found the imported fixture row.

checks.name: test_tscheck_import
checks.evidence: Live HTTP suite: admin POST /api/import/products returned 200 with imported=1 and GET /api/products contained the imported fixture SKU.

checks.criterion: Responsividade e ausência de erros críticos
checks.name: responsive-main-flow
checks.evidence: Desktop 1280x720 login, dashboard, theme toggle, and products navigation rendered without blank screen or failed check.
